title: Quick Spicy Japanese Collards Paella
description: A jain-friendly, spicy and flaky brunch dish cooked in a paella pan, featuring tender collard greens, short‑grain rice and a punchy Japanese flavor profile.
instructions: Heat the paella pan over medium heat and add the toasted sesame oil.
Add the chili paste and sauté for 30 seconds to release its aroma.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a gentle simmer.
Stir in the rice, soy sauce, miso paste, mirin and a pinch of salt, then cover and cook for 12 minutes.
After 12 minutes, add the collard greens, stirring to coat them with the sauce and rice.
Cover again and simmer for an additional 5 minutes until the rice absorbs the liquid and the greens are tender.
Remove the pan from heat, sprinkle toasted sesame seeds and nori strips over the top.
Let the paella rest for 3 minutes, then squeeze fresh lime juice before serving.
